observations: Five, ten and twenty files produced ten, forty-five and 190 unordered pairs.
Diagrams drew every connecting comparison edge for small sizes, visibly becoming dense at twenty.
Thousand-file preset reported 499,500 and explicitly said too many to draw, but the Files slider and label remained twenty.
Reveal retained all four visited cases and derived n times n-minus-one divided by two, distinguishing 4.2-fold from exact fourfold growth in the small example.
